name: Home page paste box renders
steps: GET / as an anonymous visitor
assertions: textarea#md is visible
a Share button is visible

name: Creating a paste from the home page UI returns a share link
steps: type markdown into textarea#md
click the 'Share →' button
wait for #result / #link to appear
assertions: #link href matches /v/<id>
#result becomes visible

name: Anonymous visit to a private paste shows the login gate, no leak
steps: seed a private paste with a secret title+body via POST /api/share
anonymous browser context navigates to /v/:id
assertions: input#pwd (password gate) is visible
page does not contain the seeded secret title
page does not contain the seeded secret body

name: After owner login, the paste renders its markdown (heading/table)
steps: seed a private paste whose markdown has an H1 heading and a table
log in as owner via the real /dashboard login form
navigate to /v/:id
assertions: #content h1 text matches the seeded heading
#content contains a rendered <table>

name: Raw route (/raw/:id) follows the real anon-vs-owner contract
steps: seed a private paste with known raw content
GET /raw/:id anonymously
log in as owner, GET /raw/:id again
assertions: anonymous GET /raw/:id is not 200 and does not return the content
owner GET /raw/:id is 200 with the exact raw content

name: Owner dashboard lists the paste
steps: seed a paste with a distinctive title
log in as owner, navigate to /dashboard
assertions: the seeded paste's title appears in the dashboard list

name: Publish makes a paste anonymously viewable; unpublish restores the gate
steps: seed a private paste
owner opens /v/:id and clicks 'Share publicly' (confirm dialog accepted)
anonymous context loads /v/:id and sees content
owner clicks 'Stop sharing' (confirm dialog accepted)
anonymous context reloads /v/:id and sees the gate again
assertions: after publish, anonymous request sees the content, not the gate
after unpublish, anonymous request sees the gate again

name: Diagram create (API) and render, owner vs anonymous
steps: POST /api/diagram with an SVG containing a marker string
anonymous browser visits /d/:id
owner (logged in) visits /d/:id
assertions: anonymous visit sees the login gate, not the marker
owner visit sees the SVG marker rendered on the page

name: Archify create (API) and render, sandboxed iframe without allow-same-origin
steps: POST /api/archify with kind+html+markdown
anonymous browser visits /a/:id
owner (logged in) visits /a/:id
assertions: anonymous visit sees the login gate
owner visit's page HTML contains an <iframe sandbox="allow-scripts" ...>
that sandbox attribute does NOT contain allow-same-origin

name: Agent token create via dashboard UI, bearer read per scope, then revoke -> 401
steps: owner opens /dashboard, opens the API Tokens panel, creates a documents:read token
use the raw token as a Bearer header to GET a private paste's raw content
owner revokes the token via the dashboard
repeat the bearer GET and expect 401
assertions: token creation reveals a raw token value in the UI
bearer GET with documents:read reads a private row it did not create (library-wide read)
bearer GET after revoke returns 401

name: Pin and delete, as exposed by the dashboard/render UI
steps: seed a paste, owner pins it from the dashboard's select/batch-pin UI
seed a second paste, owner deletes it from its /v/:id page
assertions: pinned paste shows a 'Pinned' badge on the dashboard after pinning
deleted paste's raw content 404s afterward
